facts.statement: Batyrosaurus was named and described in 2012 by Pascal Godefroit, François Escuillié, Yuri Bolotsky, and Pascaline Lauters.
facts.quote: The type species Batyrosaurus rozhdestvenskyi was in 2012 named and described by Pascal Godefroit, François Escuillié, Yuri Bolotsky and Pascaline Lauters.

facts.statement: Batyrosaurus is known from the Late Cretaceous Bostobe Formation in central Kazakhstan, and researchers suggest it may be the same taxon as the doubtful Arstanosaurus akkurganensis found in the same formation.
facts.quote: It contains a single species, Batyrosaurus rozhdestvenskyi. It is possible that Batyrosaurus represents the same taxon as the doubtful Arstanosaurus akkurganensis as both were found from the same formation.

facts.statement: The genus name Batyrosaurus is derived from the Batyr, the Kazakh hero warriors.
facts.quote: The generic name is derived from the Batyr, the Kazakh hero warriors.

facts.statement: The specific name rozhdestvenskyi honors the paleontologist Anatoly Konstantinovich Rozhdestvensky.
facts.quote: The specific name honours Anatoly Konstantinovich Rozhdestvensky.

facts.statement: Batyrosaurus was a medium-sized hadrosauroid measuring about five to six meters in length.
facts.quote: Batyrosaurus is a medium-sized hadrosauroid of about five to six metres length.

facts.statement: The rear parietal bones formed bony flaps that overlapped the supraoccipital and were overlapped by the squamosals.
facts.quote: The parietal bones at their rear form bony flaps that overlap the supraoccipital but do not touch the sides of the paraoccipitals and are themselves overlapped by the squamosals.

facts.statement: The frontal bones were elongated, approximately 70% longer than they were wide.
facts.quote: The frontal bones are elongated, about 70% longer than wide.

facts.statement: A thumb claw measuring about four centimeters long was found among the fossil material.
facts.quote: Among the material found was an about four centimetres long thumb claw.

facts.statement: A cast of the braincase revealed fine arterial impressions, indicating the braincase was almost completely filled by brain tissue.
facts.quote: A cast was made of the braincase, showing fine arterial impressions on its inner surface, indicating it was almost completely filled by brain tissue.

facts.statement: Cladistic analysis places Batyrosaurus in a basal position within Hadrosauroidea, above Altirhinus but below Probactrosaurus.
facts.quote: A cladistic analysis showed that Batyrosaurus had a basal position in the Hadrosauroidea, above Altirhinus but below Probactrosaurus in the evolutionary tree.

facts.statement: Batyrosaurus lived during the Santonian to Campanian stages, from 85.7 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Campanian (85.7 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Batyrosaurus belongs to the parent group Hadrosauroidea.
Batyrosaurus is classified in the class Ornithischia.

rejected.quote: The holotype, AEHM 4/1, was found near Akkurgan in a layer of the Bostobinskaya Formation dating from the Santonian-Campanian, about eighty-four millions year old.
